hotspots.label: Helmet
hotspots.title: Advanced Composite Helmet
hotspots.description: Lightweight carbon-fiber composite shell with an integrated visor locking system and oxygen mask mount point. Rated for altitudes up to 25,000 ft.

hotspots.label: Oxygen System
hotspots.title: Pressurized Oxygen Delivery Tube
hotspots.description: Reinforced silicone oxygen supply tube running from the helmet to the chest-mounted regulator. Withstands pressures up to 300 PSI and extreme temperature swings.

hotspots.label: Chest Regulator
hotspots.title: Pressure Regulator Unit
hotspots.description: Dual-redundant chest-mounted pressure regulator automatically adjusts oxygen flow based on altitude and breathing demand.
